_doc: The host's lines in the trailer (compositions Trailer and TrailerAnimatic; plan: docs/notes/2026-11-26-trailer-plan.md). Same fields as narration.drama.json ('text' caption, 'say' spoken form) plus 'en' (the English caption under it). The voice is the drama version's. 'npm run tts:trailer' reads it into public/narration-trailer/<scene>_<k>.mp3; where a line sits on the clock is in src/trailer/timing.ts.
